The '''Wannschok Tenements''' was a section of the [[Nikto Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was named after the [[Wannschok]], a famous [[Desert/Legends|desert]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. [[Sawtooth Salvage]] and the [[Alien Arms Bazaar]] were located in the area, as was the [[Power Guard recruitment center|recruitment center]] for the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]], and the [[Kintan Kings]] gang controlled the area as they did the entire Nikto Sector.
